section_summary.extract_value: This Discussion section examines body appreciation among sexual minority women using objectification theory as a framework. The authors report that sexual minority women showed higher mean body appreciation scores than heterosexual women, though the effect size was very small (η²=.012), and that the correlation between BMI and body appreciation (BAS) was stronger for heterosexual women but not statistically significantly different (z=.41, p=.34). The study comprised two samples collected at different time points, with participants described as primarily educated White women, which the authors acknowledge as a significant limitation affecting generalizability.
